title: Pipette Pump Coupling
brief: Directly grasp, transfer, and stably place Dry practice pipette pump on the named real work-surface zones; no unmodeled laboratory operation or measurement is simulated.

migration.legacyLearningObjective: Program the pump-to-pipette coupling sequence with compatibility feedback and observable confirmation.

pipette_pump_destination.semantic: Semantic transfer frame above the tallest configured resting apparatus plus the carried item's complete lower envelope and a 24 mm physical clearance; release occurs only at the distinct placement-contact frame.

pipette_pump_place_contact.semantic: Physical direct-apparatus placement contact; the item's real footprint rests on the broad receiving workbench zone.

calibration.statement: The simulation rest pose is not a physical home or calibration result. LeRobot calibration stores device-specific homing offsets, drive modes, and ranges.

commandShape.uncommandedPhysicalBehavior: SOFollower does not include an unprovided motor in that Goal_Position sync_write.
commandShape.uncommandedSimulationBehavior: RoboBuddy retains each uncommanded joint at its current simulated position.
commandShape.unknownFieldSimulationBehavior: RoboBuddy rejects unknown fields instead of silently ignoring non-position metadata.

relativeTargetGuard.physicalBehavior: When configured, SOFollower may clip supplied goals relative to a fresh Present_Position read and returns the clipped action actually sent.
relativeTargetGuard.simulationBehavior: Not modeled. RoboBuddy applies its explicit URDF-envelope and collision guardrails, then returns the accepted supplied targets unchanged.

timing.physicalSemantics: Each LeRobot send_action call writes the supplied Goal_Position subset, optionally clipped by max_relative_target; motor/controller timing is not modeled by the physical API surface.
timing.simulationSemantics: RoboBuddy linearly interpolates between accepted targets only to make awaited command order visible. This is not servo dynamics or a hardware timing guarantee.
